papers.title: WSi weak link element with a non-sinusoidal current-phase relation
papers.abstract: Nonlinearity is an essential ingredient for encoding quantum states with non-uniform energy spacing, implementing coherent quantum gates, reading out qubits, amplifying, and mixing electromagnetic signals. In this work, we demonstrate the nonlinear behavior of a constriction fabricated from an amorphous, high-kinetic inductance material, tungsten silicide, embedded in a three-dimensional RF-SQUID. We find that the results are consistent with the weak link behaving as a Josephson junction with a sawtooth-like current-phase relation or a quantum phase slip element. Finally, we measure relaxation times of the metastable, persistent-current states trapped in the local minima of the potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate the nonlinear behavior”、“measure relaxation times”等实验操作和测量行为。；研究对象：非晶态高动能电感材料钨硅化物（WSi）制成的微桥（constriction）弱连接元件，嵌入三维射频超导量子干涉器（RF-SQUID）中，研究其电流-相位关系及非线性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该弱连接元件的非线性行为与具有锯齿状电流-相位关系的约瑟夫森结或量子相位滑移元件一致；测量了势能局部极小值中亚稳态持续电流态的弛豫时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该弱连接元件的非线性行为与具有锯齿状电流-相位关系的约瑟夫森结或量子相位滑移元件一致；测量了势能局部极小值中亚稳态持续电流态的弛豫时间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备非晶WSi微桥并嵌入三维RF-SQUID，通过测量其非线性响应和弛豫时间来分析电流-相位关系。

papers.title: Probing Lattice Dynamics in Real-Space and Real-Time
papers.abstract: The coherent lattice vibrations significantly impact physical and chemical processes in solids, such as heat transfer, displacive phase transitions, and thermal conductivity. Thus, probing lattice dynamics in real-space and real-time is essential for understanding ubiquitous phenomena in solids. High-harmonic spectroscopy (HHS) has emerged as a preferred technique for investigating static and dynamic properties of solids on ultrafast timescales. Yet, despite these accomplishments, the applicability of HHS to probe the influence of coherent lattice vibrations on electronic responses has remained unexplored. In this thesis, we explore the impact of coherent lattice dynamics on attosecond electronic responses in solids using HHS. We observe that coherent excitation of the in-plane phonon mode in graphene results in sidebands in the harmonic spectrum, separated by the frequency of the excited phonon mode. Additionally, we demonstrate the capability of HHS to characterize energy, polarization, phase difference, and the "chirality" of phonon modes. This thesis offers an avenue to probe phonon-driven processes in solids with sub-cycle temporal resolution. In the later segment, our focus shifts toward probing coherent lattice dynamics in real-space and real-time. We demonstrate that inelastic scattering techniques, combined with theoretical analysis, yield comparable results to those from time-resolved diffraction and imaging measurements within pump-probe configurations. Our findings exhibit excellent agreement with results from a time-resolved diffuse x-ray scattering experiment. Our proposed method serves as an alternative to time-resolved diffraction and imaging methods for probing lattice dynamics in real-space and real-time with atomic-scale spatiotemporal resolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算与实验混合类型。关键词：high-harmonic spectroscopy (HHS)、inelastic scattering techniques、theoretical analysis、time-resolved diffuse x-ray scattering experiment。；研究对象：固体中的相干晶格动力学（coherent lattice dynamics），具体以石墨烯（graphene）的面内声子模为研究对象，探讨其对电子响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用高次谐波光谱（HHS）观察到石墨烯中相干激发面内声子模会在谐波谱中产生边带，边带间隔等于激发声子模的频率；同时，HHS能够表征声子模的能量、偏振、相位差及“手性”。此外，非弹性散射技术结合理论分析可在实空间和实时间上探测晶格动力学，结果与时间分辨衍射/成像测量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用高次谐波光谱（HHS）观察到石墨烯中相干激发面内声子模会在谐波谱中产生边带，边带间隔等于激发声子模的频率；同时，HHS能够表征声子模的能量、偏振、相位差及“手性”。此外，非弹性散射技术结合理论分析可在实空间和实时间上探测晶格动力学，结果与时间分辨衍射/成像测量一致。；创新点：首次探索了高次谐波光谱（HHS）在探测相干晶格振动对电子响应影响方面的适用性，并展示了其表征声子模式多种性质（能量、偏振、相位差、手性）的能力；同时提出非弹性散射技术作为时间分辨衍射/成像方法的替代方案，用于实现原子级时空分辨率的晶格动力学探测。
papers.method_zh: 高次谐波光谱（HHS）用于探测超快时间尺度上的电子响应；非弹性散射技术（inelastic scattering techniques）结合理论分析用于实空间/实时间晶格动力学探测；结果与时间分辨漫散射X射线实验（time-resolved diffuse x-ray scattering experiment）进行对比验证。

papers.title: TriForces: Augmenting Atomistic GNNs for Transferable Representations
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) achieve excellent accuracy when trained on large Density Functional Theory (DFT) data. To be useful in practice, they must often be adapted to target chemistries using small and expensive task-specific datasets. However, MLIPs transfer inconsistently across domains, with representations that often loose accessible composition and structure information. To address this, we present TriForces, a model-agnostic three-stream framework that separates composition and structure information, combined with self-supervised learning to preserve transferable representations. TriForces improves performance on MatBench and QM9 over baselines without needing DFT labels and enables efficient similar structure retrieval through its learned latent space. On OMat24, in limited-data training regime, TriForces reduces energy MAE by 57% at 20K samples only and improves force MAE across sample sizes. We release pretrained TriForces variants across multiple MLIP architectures with code at https://github.com/Ramlaoui/triforces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、self-supervised learning、latent space、energy MAE、force MAE。；研究对象：原子间势能（interatomic potentials）的机器学习模型，具体涉及材料数据集MatBench、QM9和OMat24中的多种化学体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出TriForces框架，通过分离组成与结构信息并结合自监督学习，在有限数据训练下显著降低能量和力的预测误差（例如在OMat24上仅用2万样本将能量MAE降低57%），并实现可迁移的表示学习。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出TriForces框架，通过分离组成与结构信息并结合自监督学习，在有限数据训练下显著降低能量和力的预测误差（例如在OMat24上仅用2万样本将能量MAE降低57%），并实现可迁移的表示学习。；创新点：提出一种模型无关的三流架构，显式分离组成与结构信息，并通过自监督学习增强表示的可迁移性，从而在少量目标数据下仍能保持良好性能，同时支持相似结构的高效检索。
papers.method_zh: 模型无关的三流（three-stream）框架，将组成信息与结构信息分离处理；结合自监督学习（self-supervised learning）以保持可迁移的表示；在多个MLIP架构上预训练并发布模型。

papers.title: Ultrafast excitation of Bloch plasmon polaritons in hyperbolic metamaterials with an extreme ultra-violet transient grating
papers.abstract: Manipulating materials properties with light drives advances in materials science and photonics. Hyperbolic metamaterials are promising candidates as next-generation quantum optical media. They support Bloch plasmon polaritons, which are characterized by potentially infinite wave-vectors and long lifetimes, but cannot be excited through direct light illumination due to momentum mismatch. Here, we experimentally show that a transient grating, formed via interference of fully coherent seeded free-electron laser pulses in a thin insulator film, enables the excitation of Bloch plasmon polaritons in an underlying hyperbolic metamaterial. Finite element simulations confirm the role of the transient grating in facilitating phase-matching and mode excitation. Our findings demonstrate a route to spatiotemporally excite Bloch plasmon polaritons modes, offering an alternative to permanently nanostructured gratings and potentially enabling ultrafast control of optical modes excitation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimentally show”、“finite element simulations”（辅助验证）。；研究对象：双曲超材料中的布洛赫等离激元极化激元（Bloch plasmon polaritons），以及通过瞬态光栅激发该模式的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用全相干种子自由电子激光脉冲在薄膜中干涉形成的瞬态光栅，成功实现了对双曲超材料中布洛赫等离激元极化激元的激发，解决了动量失配问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用全相干种子自由电子激光脉冲在薄膜中干涉形成的瞬态光栅，成功实现了对双曲超材料中布洛赫等离激元极化激元的激发，解决了动量失配问题。；创新点：提出并实验演示了用瞬态光栅替代永久性纳米结构光栅，实现布洛赫等离激元极化激元的时空激发，为超快控制光学模式激发提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用全相干种子自由电子激光脉冲在薄绝缘膜中形成瞬态光栅，激发下层双曲超材料中的布洛赫等离激元极化激元；理论上结合有限元模拟验证瞬态光栅在相位匹配和模式激发中的作用。

papers.title: Ultrafast temperature diagnosis of dynamically compressed matter using millielectronvolt inelastic x-ray scattering beyond the first Brillouin zone
papers.abstract: We present calculations of the millielectronvolt-scale x-ray scattering spectra of multilayered dynamic-compression targets comprising an unstructured ablator layer and a crystalline, textured sample layer. Our model builds on the classic formulation of x-ray thermal diffuse scattering by Warren [B. E. Warren, Acta Crystallogr. 6, 803 (1953)] and includes both elastic and first-order (single-phonon) inelastic scattering contributions to the dynamic structure factor $S(\mathbf{q},ω)$. We focus on the umklapp scattering regime (i.e., at momentum transfers outside the first Brillouin zone) where the ablator scattering that threatens to overwhelm the inelastic scattering from the crystalline layer of interest is suppressed. We show that, despite the considerably more complex structure of the inelastic scattering spectra in this intermediate-$q$ regime, it is still possible to reliably deduce the temperature of the crystal using Dornheim's Laplace-transform--based formalism [Dornheim et al., Phys. Plasmas 30, 042707 (2023)], regardless of the details of the sample's texture.

papers.title: The dual Ginzburg-Landau theory for a holographic superfluid/superconductor: Critical dynamics
papers.abstract: Holographic superfluids/superconductors are one of the most studied systems in the AdS/CFT duality. In the low-energy, in the long-wavelength limit, they should be described by a Ginzburg-Landau theory. For critical dynamics, one expects that they belong to "model F" universality class. We consider a bulk 5-dimensional holographic superfluid/superconductor in the probe limit. For the holographic superconductor, we impose the boundary Maxwell equation to make the boundary Maxwell field dynamical. We identify the dual model F equations where numerical coefficients are obtained exactly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“AdS/CFT duality”、“Ginzburg-Landau theory”、“model F universality class”、“identify the dual model F equations”。；研究对象：全息超流体/超导体的临界动力学，具体为5维全息超流体/超导体在探针极限下的模型，并考虑边界麦克斯韦场动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低能长波极限下，全息超流体/超导体应属于“模型F”普适类，并且作者精确推导出了对应的对偶模型F方程中的数值系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低能长波极限下，全息超流体/超导体应属于“模型F”普适类，并且作者精确推导出了对应的对偶模型F方程中的数值系数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。

papers.title: Sampling Noise and Optimized Measurement Distribution in Imaginary-Time Quantum Dynamics Simulations
papers.abstract: Variational quantum dynamics simulations (VQDS) provide a promising route to simulate real- and imaginary-time quantum dynamics on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices using fixed-depth circuits. However, their practical performance is strongly limited by sampling noise arising from a finite number of circuit measurements. In this work, we systematically investigate the impact of sampling noise on VQDS, with a focus on ground-state preparation in one-dimensional Ising spin models using imaginary time evolution. We compare different regularization strategies for stabilizing the equations of motion and show that Tikhonov regularization provides robust performance in noisy imaginary-time evolution. We then benchmark measurement-distribution strategies that allocate shots by minimizing a cost function that characterizes the error in solving the equation of motion. Using noisy circuit simulations, we demonstrate that such optimized shot allocation can significantly improve state fidelity and reduce the total measurement cost by more than a factor of two compared to uniform shot distributions. We observe that the best results are found if a sufficiently large number of measurements is guaranteed for all circuits, suggesting that a finite fraction of shots should be distributed evenly. Our results provide practical guidelines for implementing measurement-efficient variational quantum dynamics and ground-state preparation on near-term quantum hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：variational quantum dynamics simulations (VQDS)、noisy circuit simulations、regularization strategies。；研究对象：一维伊辛自旋模型（one-dimensional Ising spin models）中的基态制备，通过虚时间演化（imaginary time evolution）实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在含噪变分量子动力学模拟中，采用Tikhonov正则化可稳健处理运动方程的不稳定性；通过优化测量分配（optimized shot allocation）能显著提升态保真度，并将总测量成本降低至均匀分配的一半以下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在含噪变分量子动力学模拟中，采用Tikhonov正则化可稳健处理运动方程的不稳定性；通过优化测量分配（optimized shot allocation）能显著提升态保真度，并将总测量成本降低至均匀分配的一半以下。；创新点：系统研究了采样噪声对VQDS的影响，并提出了基于代价函数优化的测量分配策略，同时发现为所有电路保证足够多的测量次数（即均匀分配一部分测量资源）是获得最佳结果的关键。摘要未突出说明与已有优化策略的具体对比细节。

papers.title: 2D GaSe-Based Single-Pixel Spectrometer via Electro-Optical Barrier Co-Modulation
papers.abstract: Driven by the growing demand for miniaturized spectrometers for in-situ analysis, and point-of-care diagnostics, conventional spectrometers are often constrained by bulky architectures and pathlength-limited spectral resolution. Achieving high-resolution, single-pixel computational spectrometers is therefore critical for the realization of compact, on-chip systems. Here, we report a single-pixel spectrometer enabled by a single 2D material; few-layer GaSe-based photodetector, in which the Schottky barrier height modulation, governed jointly by applied bias and optical excitation, provides an efficient mechanism for spectral encoding without the need for bulky dispersive elements. The device exhibits a high peak-wavelength accuracy of ~0.78 nm across a broad operational bandwidth (300-700 nm) within a compact footprint of ~100 um^2 and resolves closely spaced spectral features with separations down to ~5 nm. The device operates at low bias (+/- 4V) with an ultralow dark current density ~0.3 pA/um^2 at 4V bias. These results establish a simple, scalable route toward compact, cost-effective spectroscopic systems for on-chip spectral sensing and portable hyperspectral imaging applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了器件的制备（基于少层GaSe的光电探测器）和性能表征（峰值波长精度、工作带宽、暗电流等）。；研究对象：基于二维材料GaSe（硒化镓）的单像素光谱仪。具体体系为少层GaSe光电探测器，利用其肖特基势垒高度调制效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过电学和光学协同调制（偏压和光激发共同调控肖特基势垒高度），在单个二维GaSe器件上实现了无需色散元件的单像素光谱探测，在紧凑的尺寸（~100 μm²）和宽工作带宽（300-700 nm）内达到了~0.78 nm的峰值波长精度和~5 nm的光谱分辨能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过电学和光学协同调制（偏压和光激发共同调控肖特基势垒高度），在单个二维GaSe器件上实现了无需色散元件的单像素光谱探测，在紧凑的尺寸（~100 μm²）和宽工作带宽（300-700 nm）内达到了~0.78 nm的峰值波长精度和~5 nm的光谱分辨能力。；创新点：提出并实验验证了一种基于单一二维材料（GaSe）的、通过电-光协同调制肖特基势垒来实现光谱编码的单像素光谱仪方案，避免了传统光谱仪中笨重的色散元件，为实现紧凑、低成本、片上集成的光谱传感系统提供了一条简单、可扩展的路径。

papers.title: Orbital-Angular-Momentum Entangled Photon Emission from Circular Currents in Semiconductor-Superconductor Structures
papers.abstract: We theoretically demonstrate that a superconducting circular current induced in a semiconductor results in emission of orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) entangled photon pairs upon carrier recombination. Combining the macroscopic Ginzburg-Landau theory and the microscopic Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory, we investigate the emission of a superconducting light-emitting diode (SLED) with a spatially varying phase profile in the superconducting order parameter. We show that in the active region of the SLED with a circular supercurrent, radiative recombination processes inherit the order parameter phase and result in photon pairs emitted into modes of different OAM quantum numbers. We demonstrate that coherent superposition of superconducting qubit eigenstates can also be mapped onto a coherent superposition of emitted photon states. We also show that other recombination processes due to thermally excited quasi particles do not significantly degrade the state purity. Our results introduce an original scheme for generating OAM-entangled photons enabling a new method of transmitting superconducting qubit information to photonic channels thereby bridging the gap between solid-state and photon-based platforms for quantum communications and information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically demonstrate、investigate、show、introduce（理论推导与模型分析，无实验数据或数值计算细节）。；研究对象：半导体-超导体结构中的超导发光二极管（SLED），具体研究其中环形超导电流诱导的载流子复合过程，以及由此产生的轨道角动量（OAM）纠缠光子对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超导发光二极管的活性区中，环形超导电流的相位分布会通过辐射复合过程传递给发射的光子，从而产生具有不同OAM量子数的纠缠光子对；超导量子比特本征态的相干叠加可映射为发射光子态的相干叠加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超导发光二极管的活性区中，环形超导电流的相位分布会通过辐射复合过程传递给发射的光子，从而产生具有不同OAM量子数的纠缠光子对；超导量子比特本征态的相干叠加可映射为发射光子态的相干叠加。；创新点：提出一种利用超导环形电流直接产生OAM纠缠光子的新方案，将超导量子比特信息映射到光子通道，为固态与光子平台之间的量子通信与信息处理架起桥梁。

papers.title: Poles-zeros duality in semi-holographic Mott insulators
papers.abstract: Inspired by the poles-zeros duality of Green's functions that appears in transitions into Mott-insulating phases in strongly correlated condensed matter systems, we propose a semi-holographic approach to Mott insulators. In this model, a fundamental fermion is coupled to a large-$N$, strongly interacting sector that generates a self-energy for the fundamental fermion's Green's function. This coupling amounts to a hybridization of the fundamental fermion with a strongly correlated fermionic composite. Within the holographic framework, at large $N$, the Green's function of the composite fermion naturally exhibits a poles-zeros duality. Zeros of the Green's function are caused by the poles of the self-energy that correspond to collective many-body excitations of the holographic strongly interacting sector. We calculate the spectral function of the fundamental fermion, from which we characterize the semi-holographic metallic and the Mott-insulating phases. In addition to the new physical interpretation of the zeros, our analysis yields a well-defined picture of the poles-zeros duality in terms of the freedom to choose between standard and alternative quantization in the strongly coupled sector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出半全息模型、基于大N展开和格林函数极点-零点对偶性分析。；研究对象：Mott绝缘体中的半全息金属-绝缘体相变，以及强关联费米子体系中格林函数的极点-零点对偶性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半全息模型中，基本费米子与强关联全息扇区耦合后，其格林函数的零点由全息扇区集体多体激发的自能极点产生，从而在强耦合扇区中通过标准量子化与替代量子化的选择自由，实现了对极点-零点对偶性的清晰物理解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半全息模型中，基本费米子与强关联全息扇区耦合后，其格林函数的零点由全息扇区集体多体激发的自能极点产生，从而在强耦合扇区中通过标准量子化与替代量子化的选择自由，实现了对极点-零点对偶性的清晰物理解释。；创新点：首次在半全息框架下将Mott绝缘体中的格林函数零点解释为全息强关联扇区集体激发的自能极点，并利用全息对偶中标准/替代量子化的自由度统一描述极点-零点对偶性。
papers.method_zh: 半全息方法（semi-holographic approach）：将基本费米子与一个大N强相互作用全息扇区耦合，通过全息对偶计算复合费米子的格林函数，并分析基本费米子的谱函数以区分金属相和Mott绝缘相。
